@@U00900@@
Ah! You see? Youre talking sense again! Yes, there zs a natural means to recover youth, but that’s a chapter in another book, and a very curious one at that, I may say.

@@U00902@@
Tell me! I insist.

@@U00904@@
Good! It calls for neither money, magic, nor medicine! Get yourself out into a country field, start hoeing, start digging, confine yourself and your thoughts to a narrow sphere of reference, eat the simple foods you raise, live with your beasts of burden as a beast, be proud to manure the fields with your own dung. Believe me, there’s no better way to keep yourself young at eighty.

@@U00906@@
No, I could never do that. I’m just not used to such things. Dig with a spade? I could never manage so narrow an existence.

@@U00908@@
Well, then, the witch it will have to be.

@@U00910@@
But why the old hag? Can't you brew it yourself?

@@U00912@@
Oh, that would be a splendid pastime! In the time it would take I could build a thousand bridges.
translation:
@@U00900@@
啊！你看？你又讲道理了！是的，有一种恢复青春的自然方法，但那是另一本书的一章，我可以说，这是一个非常奇怪的章节。

@@U00902@@
告诉我！我坚持。

@@U00904@@
好！它不需要金钱，魔法，也不需要药物！让自己进入乡村田地，开始锄地，开始挖掘，将自己和思想限制在一个狭窄的参考范围内，吃自己种植的简单食物，像野兽一样与驮畜一起生活，为用自己的粪便给田地施肥而感到自豪。相信我，没有比这更好的方法让自己在八十岁时保持年轻了。

@@U00906@@
不，我永远不能那样做。我只是不习惯这样的事情。用铁锹挖？我永远无法过如此狭隘的生活。

@@U00908@@
那么，那就一定是女巫了。

@@U00910@@
但为什么是老太婆呢？自己泡不可以吗？

@@U00912@@
哦，那将是一次美妙的消遣！在这段时间里我可以建造一千座桥梁。
